title: Precision materials processing and component production
description: On request, we provide manufacturing processes that alter the shape and dimensions of the supplied material to transform it into a finished/required component.

blocks.text: Transforming raw materials into finished components
On request, we provide manufacturing processes that alter the shape and dimensions of the supplied material to transform it into a finished/required component.

items: Machining of metal components (Automotive): Comprehensive services utilizing CNC, lathes, and milling machines. We also offer professional welding and a wide range of metalworking services.
Machining of plastic components: Specialist machining of plastic elements, dedicated to the rigorous standards of the automotive industry.
Subtractive machining (cutting): Precision removal of excess material to produce components with the desired surface finish.
Screen printing: Durable and precise application of markings, logos and graphics onto technical components.
Rework (Repair and refreshing): Professional repair processes aimed at restoring defective elements to full compliance with specifications, which allows for the reduction of material losses.
Cleaning: Removal of post-production contaminants, grease and filings, preparing details for further assembly stages or shipping.

blocks.text: Certainty of execution and an efficient supply chain

items: Quality control and sorting of parts: Rigorous verification of each element for material and dimensional defects. We guarantee that only components that are 100% compliant with the order will reach the client.
Component transport: Safe internal and external logistics, ensuring continuity of supply and protection of finished products against damage.
